description: Source code implementing streaming and filtering mechanisms for object database in a version control system, including stream structures, read functions, and stream filtering logic.

classes.name: odb_filtered_read_stream
classes.description: Stream structure for filtered reading with internal buffers and filter state.

classes.name: odb_incore_read_stream
classes.description: In-core stream structure for reading object data directly from memory.

methods.name: close_istream_filtered
methods.description: Closes filtered stream, frees filter, and closes upstream stream.

methods.name: read_istream_filtered
methods.description: Reads filtered data from the stream, processing through the filter.

methods.name: attach_stream_filter
methods.description: Attaches a stream filter to an existing stream, returning a new filtered stream.

methods.name: close_istream_incore
methods.description: Closes in-core stream and frees associated buffer.

methods.name: open_istream_incore
methods.description: Opens an in-core stream by reading object info and loading data into memory.

methods.name: istream_source
methods.description: Attempts to source object data from packfiles or loose objects, defaults to in-core.
